claim: Best Streaming service for NBA games? : r/nba - Reddit
summary: Yep, adblocker + streameast. If Streameast doesn't have a game I go to one that ends in surge and find a stream there. There's always 10+ sources. Works pretty nicely with the BrowseHere browser on a Google TV, it often fetches the video stream from the page and plays it optimized without even having to fuss with blank pop-up ad whack-a-mole
